name: Marcus T.
text: Been doing box jumps 2x a week with my squat training and my vertical is up 3 inches. The key is really the recovery piece - I was burning out until I cut the volume in half.

name: Sarah K.
text: Great article but I'm still confused about the programming. Should plyos come before or after heavy lifting in the session? Currently doing them after and feeling pretty fatigued.
